access_notes: URL verification was fully unavailable this run. WebFetch returned HTTP 403 Forbidden for every URL attempted, including property portals (PropertyGuru, 99.co, EdgeProp), aggregators, and a neutral control page (en.wikipedia.org). curl egress returned HTTP 000 for all non-allowlisted hosts including example.com, so no listing page could be opened or verified.

WebSearch was functional and returned indexed snippets, but the non-negotiable rule requires a working URL that is opened/verified live this run from the actual source. No candidate URL could be opened/verified, so per rule every candidate was dropped rather than shown.

Agent proxy status reported healthy with no relay failures; the blocks are org egress policy (curl 403/407 -> report blocked host, do not route around) plus portal anti-bot 403 (WebFetch). Not a fabrication-safe channel for listings this run.

diff_vs_prior.note: No listings could be verified this run, so no NEW / PRICE-CHANGED / unchanged diff could be computed against the prior snapshot. Prior-run links could not be re-opened to check price changes (same 403 block). Note: under the stricter v2 criteria (PSF < 1700, bedrooms >= 3), none of the three prior-run units would qualify anyway: The Line @ Tanjong Rhu (2054 psf, 3BR) fails PSF; Bliss @ Kovan (2BR) fails bedrooms; Flamingo Valley (2BR) fails bedrooms.
